title: AI in engineering: Q2 2026 benchmarks & research readout
summary: DX's Q2 2026 AI impact readout: near-universal adoption, about half of merged code AI-authored, PR throughput up about a quarter, but bigger PRs, falling change confidence, volatile failure rates, soaring spend and little change in innovation time.

assertions.quote: it's now pretty settled that like yes, virtually everyone is is using AI
50% of merged code uh is now AI authored
We're still not seeing 2x, 5x, 10x, but we are seeing improvement.
the DORA metric that's associated with with velocity uh deployment frequency we also see increasing
the PR size has increased along the same period of study

verdicts.note: Telemetry from DX and other vendors shows PR sizes growing alongside AI adoption, though magnitude and causality vary by organization.

Initial Claude Code PRs add a median of 48 lines against 24 for matched human PRs in the same projects (both touching a median of 2 files, similar deletions); agent PRs are larger, but this compares PR types, not a team's average PR size before and after adoption.
